scope: One bounded diagnostic proposal; no native parameter updates executed by preparation.
question: Does spatial residual supervision help beyond its implicit global-count penalty, and can removing count duplication improve the original objective?

definitions.S: .25 mean(R-C) + .5 mean(B-C) +5CDF; R=mean native regional L1 at levels1,2,3; B=conserved-blur L1.
definitions.warning: S is nonnegative in exact arithmetic but is neither scale invariant nor count preserving. This is a coefficient/constraint decomposition, not established novelty.

training.optimizer: authentic saved AdamW states; lr5e-4 wd1e-4 clip1 unchanged; moment/age/RNG reset before EVERY arm
training.precision: CUDA BF16 forward / FP32 count and losses, TF32off after new native preflight
training.sampling: same32 frozen batches of8 per state/arm, one pass, no augmentation or dense reweighting
training.compute: same head forward and original loss graph in every arm; zero terms keep control graph. Record measured walltime/memory, not equal-speed claims.

readout.not_unseen: Both checkpoint states previously trained on these source-fitting images; reused probes are development diagnostics.
readout.endpoints: one baseline per state; fixed32-update endpoint per arm, no best checkpoint selection
readout.norm_control: For each state, rescale original and candidate net parameter displacements to their smaller norm; replay65 each, no optimizer calls; no extrapolation.

gate.spatial_protection: GAME1/2/3 and normalized blur in every populated stratum versus baseline/original; normalized blur improves >=1% all/dense/extreme.
gate.norm_control: same dense gain and sparse/spatial protection versus displacement-matched original
gate.extreme_cases: each of7 AE no worse than both baseline and original beyond1e-4+1e-6*referenceAE

resource_policy.shared_GPU: Previously approved policy retained if this bounded test is later launched

prelaunch_requirements: Freeze code/release hashes after engineering tests
Native original and factored objective value/gradient parity on fixed fitting inputs
Exact preupdate model/Adam/RNG restore; numerical CUDA replay under existing tolerances; finite BF16 gradients
Two memory/disk admission checks; own-stage-only resource controller
subsequent_action: Report full gate before any new trajectory/full fit. A pass is not full-training promotion or novelty; a fail/incomplete ends the experiment.
